mappings.rationale: The concept 'microglia activation' assessed by Iba1 staining is a biological measure that does not have an equivalent in the National Fatality Review Case Reporting System (NFR-CRS) codebook v5.1.

The concept 'cell death' assessed by cleaved caspase 3 (CC3) staining is a biological measure that does not have an equivalent in the National Fatality Review Case Reporting System (NFR-CRS) codebook v5.1.

The concept 'glutamatergic transmission' assessed in the nucleus accumbens and amygdala is a biological measure that does not have an equivalent in the National Fatality Review Case Reporting System (NFR-CRS) codebook v5.1.

The concept 'hypoglossal motor nucleus (XIIn)' assessed by electrophysiological recordings from brainstem slices is a biological measure that does not have an equivalent in the National Fatality Review Case Reporting System (NFR-CRS) codebook v5.1.

source_summaries.ncfrp_v51: The National Fatality Review Case Reporting System (NFR-CRS) codebook v5.1 does not contain variables that can be used to assess biological outcomes such as microglia activation, cell death, glutamatergic transmission, or electrophysiological measures of the hypoglossal motor nucleus. The data sources in this system are primarily focused on sociological and legal aspects related to child fatalities and do not include any biological measurements.
